items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: I come to go with the Excelsior band for playing with old man Allen. ... And I was playing with old man Allen that day.

ctx.x: Was he any kin to Joe Pian? For me?

No, I was in no relation to him. He just friendly, knowed me. Yeah. And, uh, I come to go with the Excelsior band for playing with old man Allen. Mm-hmm. They had three bands out one day playing the funeral. And I was playing with old man Allen that day. And they heard me playing the drum. So my cousin Peter then got me with the Excelsior. So I started playing with the Excelsior band until I got tired. And I quit and Henry Martin took over. Then they had come out and played. Well, Henry Martin played with them a…
Who was the snare drummer then?
